marketing_description: The DeWALT DCS714B Double Bevel Fixed Miter Saw features a 10 in steel blade with 32T and offers precise miter and bevel cuts with a cutting angle of 0/22.5/33.9 deg. This cordless tool has a variable speed setting of up to 4900 RPM and is part of the MAX XR Series, providing exceptional runtime and efficiency. It is designed for easy portability with a carry handle and has a large cut capacity.
